dashboard.pagesHint: Create, edit and publish the pages of your website.

backups.uploaded: Uploaded as {name}. Restore it from the list.
backups.deleteHint: The archive is removed from the backup folder. This cannot be undone.
backups.restoreHint: Everything is replaced with the state of {date}: pages, media, menus, configuration and staff accounts. Everyone is signed out. A backup of the current state is made first, so this can be undone by restoring that one.
backups.restored: Backup restored (previous state saved as {name}). Sign in again.
backups.restoring: Restoring {name}. The site is unavailable until it finishes; don't close this page.
backups.biweeklyHint: Starts on the first one after saving
backups.retentionHint: Older automatic backups are deleted; manual and uploaded ones are kept.
backups.noFolder: Developer has not set backup folder
backups.storageHint: The folder is set by the server's Docker setup and can't be changed here. Copy archives off the server (download them, or sync the folder) to keep them safe from a disk failure. Backups are deleted after {years} years.
backups.uploadHint: Add a backup archive (.tar.gz) from another server or an earlier download
backups.emptyHint: Back up now, or turn on automatic backups above.

pages.importedMissing: Imported as draft /{slug}; {count} image not found in the media library | Imported as draft /{slug}; {count} images not found in the media library
pages.lockedDelete: Part of the site configuration, can't be deleted
pages.importHint: Create a draft page from an exported page file (.json)
pages.emptyHint: Create the first page of your website.
pages.slugRule: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (max. 100).
pages.draftHint: Draft: only staff can see it

pageExport.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
pageExport.notExport: The file is not a page export.
pageExport.newer: The file was exported by a newer CMS version.
pageExport.incomplete: The page export is incomplete (title or blocks missing).

filters.sortedNewest: Sorted by last update, newest first. Click to reverse.
filters.sortedOldest: Sorted by last update, oldest first. Click to reverse.

unsaved.title: Do you want to save the changes?
unsaved.lost: Your changes will be lost if you don’t save them.
unsaved.blocked: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

menus.badUrl: Enter a path like /about or an http(s) URL.
menus.intro: Groups of links for your website. The {main} is the navigation at the top of every public page.
menus.handleHint: Handle: the site code loads the menu by it, so it can't change
menus.dragHint: Drag rows by the handle or pages from the list: onto a line to place it there, onto the middle of an item to nest it inside. Items without a link group their children.
menus.pickerHint: Drag into the menu or click +
menus.empty: No items yet. Add an item or drag pages here from the list.
menus.label: Label
menus.draftHint: Draft pages are left out of the public menu

config.intro: Information about your website, used on its public pages.
config.logoHint: Shown in the footer and navigation of the website. PNG/WebP work best.
config.iconHint: Browser tab icon of the website. Square PNG.
config.shareImageHint: Link previews (WhatsApp, Slack...) of pages without an image of their own. 1200×630 works best.

media.deleteHint: Pages using it will no longer show the image.
media.types: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB.
media.name: Name

publish.title: Publish this page?

publish.unpublishMessage: Visitors at /{slug} get "page not found" until you publish again.

page.title: Title
page.metaDescriptionHint: Search results and link previews; empty = the first paragraph.
page.statusHint: Saving never publishes: visitors see the last published version.
page.exportHint: A copy of this page. Import it on the Pages list to create a new draft.
